_comment: Authored layer, overlaid onto the auto-derived keyword history by generate.py. Put ONLY hand-authored facts here: value grammars (LATEST release only), defaults, required-ness, one-line summaries, and deprecation/rename/reparameterisation notes. Do NOT put source-derivable facts here (keyword set, context, introduced_in, present_in) -- those come from scanning the release tags. Deprecation data should be kept consistent with bpp-lint's src/keywords.c / src/codes.c (ideally seeded from them). Value grammars are being authored keyword-by-keyword against the v4.8.7 source; entries below are the verified starter set.

scaling.summary: Scale conditional (partial) likelihoods to avoid numerical underflow.

outfile.note: BPP 4.8.0 merged outfile and mcmcfile into jobname (a filename prefix).

mcmcfile.note: BPP 4.8.0 merged outfile and mcmcfile into jobname (a filename prefix).

diploid.note: Renamed to phase; same value format (per-species 0/1 list).

migprior.note: MSC-M migration-rate prior renamed to wprior in 4.8.0.

sequenceerror.note: Recognised by the parser but aborts at runtime with 'Not implemented'; a dead BPP 3.x keyword. bpp-lint flags this (BPP023).
